english.title: Employee of financial institution makes unlawful disclosure of information regarding request or order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was an employee of a financial institution, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTITUTION..),

(A)_[when that financial institution was specified in a customer information order or an account information order]_
(B)_[when the Secretary of State had received a European investigation order under Part 3 of the Criminal Justice (European Investigation Order) Regulations 2017 to take evidence from that financial institution]_

disclosed information that

(C)_[the request to obtain customer information or account information had been received]_
(D)_[the EIO had been received]_
(E)_[the investigation that the order relates was being carried out]_
(F)_[in pursuance of the order information had been given to the authority which made the request or order]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 50(2) and (5) of the Criminal Justice (European Investigation Order) Regulations 2017.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions
None
